author: claude-code
notes: Deliberately narrow: one question, not a pavilion comparison matrix. title: Homepage simplified to 270 words; per-article feedback voting rejected in favour of a contact invitation; integrity gate bypasses closed
reason: Two owner questions - is the homepage good from a modern UI perspective, and should every article carry a thumbs up/down with results hidden. External review answered: shorten rather than redesign, and kill the voting system because 114 real sessions per 60 days cannot produce a decidable sample. Review also found a defect shipped earlier the same day and an over-claim in the About page.
author: claude-code
notes: DEFECT FIXED: the two quick-answer cards added earlier that day used a `body` field while GoodToKnow.astro renders `text`, so both shipped as a label with no answer - in a section promising a straight answer to each. Homepage then: cut to six quick answers (Where to stay has a nav entry and a category card directly below), removed the duplicate Start here eyebrow, deleted two filler intros, hid the standalone Expo feature (it was still a full-width 21:9 hero, so moving it down had changed order not weight), and reduced the credibility block to one sentence plus an About link. 515 -> 270 words. Kept the narrow-intro/full-width-grid convention (deliberate --readw reading measure, not a defect) and both card treatments. FEEDBACK VOTING REJECTED: at ~114 sessions/60d a 5 percent response rate is about 6 self-selected answers site-wide, which cannot support rankings or before/after claims, and the listing-request storage pattern (GitHub commit per write, rebuild trigger, no rate limiting or dedup) is far too heavy for an anonymous thumb. Shipped instead: a plain contact invitation on three arrival-decision articles, no endpoint, no scores, results never public. Reopen condition recorded: a named article, a specific unresolved question, an owner who will read responses, and plausible exposure for 50 responses in 60 days. INTEGRITY GATE: a missing baseline made the check silently vacuous, an emptied body was skipped, and an article deleted from disk was invisible - all three now fail the build. The About page claim that the gate refuses to publish a page that has lost content was false and is narrowed.

title: Link-for-service trade withdrawn: widget links nofollowed, licence condition removed, outreach templates rewritten as editorial notices, suppression enforced, privacy notice corrected
reason: Two-round external strategy review (Codex) of the proposed automated 'free page in exchange for a backlink' engine. The exchange is link spam under BOTH Google's spam policies (services for links; widget links) and Bing's guidelines (inbound-link manipulation) — and the site was publicly advertising it ('that link is the license'). Separately, 11 of our 12 contact emails sit in prior-consent jurisdictions (DE, AT, CH, IT, JP, RS), so there is no lawful list to run a campaign against; the 12th is the US State Department. Owner accepted the verdict: trade off the table, no outreach engine.
author: claude-code
notes: WIDGETS: link() now emits rel='nofollow noopener' (was noopener only, i.e. followed). /for-businesses no longer says the attribution link 'is the license' and /expo-2027/countdown no longer says 'that's the license'; both now state embedding is unconditional and the credit link is removable. Zero embeds exist, so no referral traffic or earned links were lost. OVERCLAIM REMOVED: 'a new website starts from zero — you start from ours' replaced with the actual scale (a few hundred visits/month, mostly Bing). TEMPLATES: all four rewritten as editorial correction notices — no offer, no claim solicitation, no link request — and the FALSE social-proof line 'Many delegations use pages like this' is gone (0 listings have ever been claimed, so it was untrue in the first sentence of a cold email). The parent-based 'booth' fallback in outreach-draft.ts is removed: it called contractors, agencies and suppliers exhibitors, and there are no exhibitor listings at all. SUPPRESSION: opt-out/declined were cosmetic — the admin still rendered a ready-to-send draft and mailto for people who had asked us to stop; those rows now render 'suppressed — do not contact' and generate nothing. PRIVACY: the notice claimed 'we do not collect names, accounts, or payment details, because the site has none' while listing masters hold named business contacts and /manage grants claim access; rewritten to describe contact-form leads, business contact records from public sources, the manage link, and the right to correction, deletion and no-contact. SECURITY: /manage?token=<64-hex> loaded GA4, whose default page_location is the FULL url — the magic-link token would have been sent to Google; BaseLayout now honours meta.noAnalytics and /manage sets it plus Referrer-Policy: no-referrer. No tokens have ever been issued, so nothing leaked. Also: manage saves committed photos on a token validated only against the BUILD-TIME snapshot, so a token revoked since the last deploy could still write images before the text save rejected it — save.ts now calls assertTokenFresh() against the live file before any write. GROWTH PLAN: the invented forecast ('200 sends → 10-20 replies, 3-8 claims, 3-8 links') is deleted, g01 reframed to owner-notifications-only (Resend/SendGrid/Zoho all prohibit cold outreach), the automatic day-7 follow-up removed, 'ask every claimed business for a link back' converted into a standing rule never to do it, and the goal/metrics rebuilt around Bing depth and citations instead of referring domains.

title: New data page: /expo-2027/contracts — the Expo 2027 contract award ledger (7 verified packages, 13 companies) + /data/expo-2027-contracts.json
reason: The replacement for the abandoned backlink engine (BB-CHG-0015). author: claude-code
notes: 7 packages, each verified today against Serbian press before publication: collective pavilions (Sigong Tech, RSD 5.28bn ex-VAT, 6 bidders, 31 Jul 2026, BAUMEISTER named subcontractor); opening+closing ceremonies (Balich Wonder Studio, RSD 2,323,514,160 ~EUR 19.78m, 4 bidders); logistics framework (Intereuropa Dobanovci, RSD 530,882,000, 15 months Oct 2026-Dec 2027); EXPO Village laundry (five-company group, RSD 401,523,628); construction supervision across three zones (Arhi Nova, RSD 261.7m); EXPO Village accommodation operator (Aurion Service + Delta Hospitality, RSD 234,645,045, 1,500 units); ticket printing (Zavod Topcider, RSD 38.2m). A 'what is not in here yet' table names the MC Group/Stratcom PR framework (reported, not yet verified) and two national tenders as out of scope. title: Known bots excluded from GA4: no tag for headless browsers, and stripped from every admin + Growth API report
reason: Singapore was the top country in the admin analytics. It is a bot: 139 sessions / 139 users in 28 days, all Direct, all Chrome desktop, exactly 1 page, 0 seconds total engagement, round-the-clock, at two screen sizes no real device reports (1280x1200, 1366x1366). The same 1366x1366 kit also arrives through residential proxies (Brazil, Pakistan and ~20 other countries, 1 page, 3-10 s). GA4 own IAB bot filter lets it through. It inflated users by ~47% and dragged engagement rate from 49% to 36%.
author: claude-code
